get.description:
Liveness: the process is running. Checks nothing else, so a database outage does not
make the orchestrator restart healthy app processes (a restart would not fix it).

Readiness: can this process serve requests now? 503 if a dependency is down, so a load
balancer stops sending traffic here until it recovers.

post.description:
Verifies the HMAC signature, stores the raw event and queues it for processing.
Returns 202 immediately; the worker does the rest. A repeated delivery returns 200.
Follow its progress with GET /events/{delivery_id}.

A plain `def`, not `async def`: the database and Celery calls below block, so FastAPI
must run this in its thread pool. Blocking inside `async def` would freeze every request.

Queue an AI review of the PR. `mode=auto`: when the PR got new commits on top of its last
review, only the files changed since are reviewed and the other findings are carried over
(incremental); otherwise everything is. `mode=full`: always everything. An identical
earlier review is reused at no cost.

get.description:
Open PRs in the order to review them, highest priority first, each with its band (P1
review first, P2, P3), the reasons, an estimated review time and the people who changed
the same files before (suggested reviewers). The totals cover every open PR; `items` holds
the first `limit`.

Priority mixes the risk score, the model's prediction, how long the PR has waited, and a
small boost for quick reviews; high-severity findings add to it.

of findings by category, findings and votes per week, results per model and prompt, merge

an incremental review carries them over. `repeats_after_rejection` counts findings raised
again after a 👎 on the same problem in the same repository.
